Active voice uses describe the action of binding or fastening something. The passive voice indicates being bound or tied up. In medical contexts, it can describe joints undergoing ankylosis—becoming abnormally stiff or fused, as if bound together. The word carries the basic sense of creating connections or constraints through binding."
